description: This file contains the implementation of an internal task scheduler class called ActivationTaskScheduler, which manages in-order, single-concurrency task processing for each activation in the Orleans distributed actor framework. It handles task queuing, execution, and inline execution logic, with detailed logging and optional statistics collection.

classes.name: ActivationTaskScheduler
classes.description: An internal sealed class that provides a single-concurrency, in-order scheduler for activation work within Orleans. It extends TaskScheduler and manages a work item group, enabling task queuing, inline execution, and diagnostics.

methods.name: GetScheduledTasks
methods.description: Returns the currently scheduled tasks from the associated work item group.

methods.name: RunTaskFromWorkItemGroup
methods.description: Executes a given task, logging a warning if execution fails.

methods.name: QueueTask
methods.description: Enqueues a task into the worker group for execution.

methods.name: TryExecuteTaskInline
methods.description: Attempts to execute a task synchronously inline if it meets certain criteria (not previously queued and context matches).

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation including the scheduler's type and ID, and the number of external work items queued.
